purpose: Canonical ten-line Prologue pacing and post-victory Finale continuity set approved by the user and promoted into the local campaign narration manifest.

lineOverrides.speaker: Last Star
lineOverrides.text: Before the dark, daylight travelled from hand to hand. From beacon to beacon.
lineOverrides.direction: Young luminous woman; intimate mythic remembrance spoken to one newly awakened person. Begin almost in a hush, let daylight glow, pause after hand to hand, and land beacon to beacon with tender loss. Spacious, expressive, and never brisk.

lineOverrides.speaker: Last Star
lineOverrides.text: The Sun-Eater could not destroy that light. So it taught the horizon itself to close.
lineOverrides.direction: Young luminous woman; warmth hardening into remembered dread. Give the first sentence grave finality, take a full reflective beat, then reveal the closing horizon with controlled fear. Spacious and cinematic; do not rush.

lineOverrides.speaker: Last Star
lineOverrides.text: Then I choose to open, before its remnant can close around us.
lineOverrides.direction: Young luminous woman; a free, certain choice made in the quiet after victory, followed by sudden awareness that something still clings to the Crown.

lineOverrides.speaker: Sun-Eater
lineOverrides.text: You broke my body. The hunger is not flesh.
lineOverrides.direction: Dying remnant of an ancient masculine void; its body is destroyed and its voice is diffused through the Crown. Wounded certainty, never a normal living presence.

lineOverrides.speaker: Last Star
lineOverrides.text: That is only its echo, clinging to the Crown.
lineOverrides.direction: Young luminous woman; instantly recognizing a dangerous afterimage rather than a living enemy, controlled and clear.

lineOverrides.speaker: Sun-Eater
lineOverrides.text: Echo or god, every road still ends in me.
lineOverrides.direction: Disintegrating Crown-bound echo of an ancient masculine void; defiance thinning at the edges as its last certainty fractures.

lineOverrides.speaker: Last Star
lineOverrides.text: Only while the Trace points inward.
lineOverrides.direction: Young luminous woman; the final strategic realization arriving through fear, concise and urgent.

lineOverrides.speaker: Bearer
lineOverrides.direction: Young adult male warrior; absolute calm, recognizing the solution without hesitation.

lineOverrides.speaker: Bearer
lineOverrides.text: Ten memories. One closed line. Outward, now.
lineOverrides.direction: Young adult male warrior; forceful release cue, building cleanly toward outward and striking now.

lineOverrides.speaker: Sun-Eater
lineOverrides.text: No. There is no mouth left to hold the dawn.
lineOverrides.direction: Final collapsing remnant of an ancient masculine void; horrified recognition that its body and dominion are already gone, dissolving into silence.

finaleSceneDraft.summary: With the Sun-Eater slain, its hunger clings to the Crown as a dying echo. The Bearer reverses the ten-sector Trace, releasing the Last Star as a dawn shared by everyone.
